photos.description: The image depicts a pre-printed voting ballot for the 2023 French elections. It displays the address “Monsieur MARTILLUS, 91052 ERLAGEN, ALLEMAGNE” and postal code “CH-1200”. The ballot includes a QR code for online modification, with text indicating “Pour toute modification d'adresse, veuillez vous adresser à la direction.”  It also states “Elections Cantonales” and “A-PRIORITY.” The date is “02 avril 2023,” and the ballot number is “1202304EC000204.”  A logo for “REPUBLIQUE ET CANTON DE GENEVE” and “Service des votations et élections” is present, along with FSC certification. The ballot is numbered “46” with “20” on the bottom.
photos.caption: Voting is serious business, but let's make it fun!

photos.description: A partially eaten shawarma wrap is prominently displayed against a dark background. The wrap is wrapped in aluminum foil and appears to contain meat, vegetables, and sauce. A television screen is visible in the blurred background, showing a person speaking. A light gray wooden surface is present, along with a blue cabinet. The image is taken from a low angle, partially obscured by a blurred foreground object, possibly a chair. The lighting is dim and warm, creating a cozy atmosphere.
photos.caption: This shawarma is living its best life while watching TV!

photos.description: The image shows a whiteboard with handwritten notes in French. The top line reads "int. given (I)" followed by “Circuit pour”. Below this, a list of tasks is written, including “voir cabinet v”, “courses d’appoint”, “nettoyage”, “aspir – Givre omelette”, “pamousse – Givre”, and “panelle → bière”. A small, gray stone is stuck to the whiteboard. To the right is a sheet of paper with mathematical equations. A red pen and a black marker are present.
photos.caption: Brainstorming brilliance and to-do lists!

photos.description: A plate of fried fish sits on a wooden table. Two golden-brown pieces of battered and fried fish are arranged on a beige, speckled ceramic plate. Slices of lemon adorn the fish. Beside the fish are a pile of golden-brown potato wedges and a small portion of scrambled eggs. A fork rests on the plate. A crumpled piece of cellophane packaging is visible beneath the plate. The background is a dark, blurred wooden surface.

photos.description: A rectangular spinach tart sits in a dark grey baking tray. The tart’s crust is a pale golden brown, while the filling is a deep, mottled green color, speckled with red pieces, likely pancetta or bacon. The filling appears slightly browned and bubbly around the edges.  The tart is placed on a dark, textured surface, possibly a stovetop, with visible heating elements in the background.  A sheet of parchment paper lines the baking tray, adding a rustic aesthetic to the dish.

photos.description: A person sits at a large, dark wooden desk positioned in front of a window. The window features multiple wooden panels with horizontal slats, casting a muted light across the room. Two monitors are displayed, showing lines of code. A laptop rests on the desk beside a keyboard and mouse. Various accessories like a headset and a small notepad are also present. A server and a black chair are visible in the background. The overall scene suggests a workspace dedicated to computer programming or development.
photos.caption: Coding my way through the day, one pixel at a time!

photos.description: A black suitcase with a zipper is positioned on a wooden floor. The suitcase has a numerical lock and a barcode label. A hand is shown reaching out and pressing the lock on the suitcase. A blurred office environment is visible in the background, including a blue folder and a mobile phone. The lighting appears to be bright and slightly warm. The focus is primarily on the suitcase and the hand interacting with it.
photos.caption: Adventure awaits, let's pack and go!

photos.description: A close-up shot of a bottle of Chartreuse Verte liqueur. The bottle is predominantly yellow with gold lettering reading “Chartreuse.” The label features a stylized “C” logo for Garnier-Duboi and details about the liqueur's production in France. The bottle’s neck is partially obscured by a blurred background of a leafy, green bush. The lighting creates a warm glow on the bottle’s surface. The bottle's capacity is listed as 435 ml.

photos.description: The image presents a top-down view of a white plastic container filled with a light brown, slightly viscous substance. The substance has a speckled texture and appears to be a cream or lotion. The container has a simple, cylindrical design with a smooth, white exterior. It rests on a wooden surface with a light brown color and a visible grain pattern. The background is blurred, emphasizing the container and its contents.  The lighting is soft and even, highlighting the texture of the substance within the container.

photos.description: Two green chalkboards are visible against a dark background. The top chalkboard displays German sentences written in chalk, utilizing grammatical structures like subject-verb-object and various verb forms. The text includes phrases like "deshalb," "weil," "informiert," and "schickmimucki." Below, the second chalkboard contains a more chaotic collection of handwritten German words and phrases, seemingly a brainstorming session or incomplete notes. Both boards appear to be in a classroom or educational setting.

The handwriting is cursive and appears to be from a student or teacher. The boards are mounted on a white wall with visible grid patterns. photos.description: A handheld hot glue gun is prominently displayed in the foreground, held in a man’s hand. The gun is black with gray accents and a white label indicating its model number and CE marking. A small, white glue stick is extended from the nozzle. The background features a blurred interior scene with wooden furniture and a pink object, suggesting a domestic setting. The overall lighting is soft and slightly diffused, casting subtle shadows. The focus is sharp on the hot glue gun, highlighting its details.

photos.description: The image presents a high-angle view of a gray tiled rooftop. The tiles are arranged in a grid pattern, and a square ventilation grate is visible in the center. A small, brown dog is lying on the rooftop, positioned diagonally. In the background, blurred buildings with dark windows and a glimpse of blue sky are visible. The image is framed by the edge of a window, suggesting the view is taken from indoors. The overall scene is quiet and minimalist, emphasizing the geometric patterns and the presence of the dog.

A fork and a knife are placed on the plate. In the background, there’s a pink envelope and another beer bottle. The composition suggests a casual meal, possibly German cuisine. A corkscrew, a small wooden box, and a Nescafe coffee container are placed on the table. Two white plates hold slices of bread and cheese. A small bag of coffee beans rests alongside a block of cheese and a jar of butter. The background is dark, creating a high-contrast effect with the illuminated table and objects. The portraits are side-by-side, depicting the same subject with slight variations in expression and lighting. One girl has dark hair and a contemplative gaze, while the other has blonde hair and a more direct, inquisitive look. The frames are dark and ornate, with faded script along the bottom edge.  A white plastic crate filled with books and a small white object are positioned beside the artwork.  The scene is captured in natural light.

photos.description: A beige envelope rests on a wooden surface, likely a table. The envelope is addressed to “Herrn Lucas Marti” at Nürnberger Straße 59, 91052 Erlangen. title: Voting Ballots of 2023 France
summary:
Here’s a fun, playful chronological summary of the picture gallery events:

It started with a French election ballot on April 2nd, complete with a QR code and a focus on voting procedures. Then, on March 26th, a shawarma was enjoying its TV time. March 27th saw a flurry of brainstorming – whiteboard notes, equations, and a slightly bewildered stone.  The 27th continued with a delicious fried fish and potato wedge feast, followed by a beautifully crafted spinach tart on March 28th.  On March 29th, a programmer was hard at work, battling lines of code, and a suitcase was getting ready for an adventure.  A taste of Chartreuse Verte was enjoyed on the same day. Then came a chaotic collection of German words on March 29th, followed by a plate of scrambled eggs and fried fish on March 29th.  April 1st kicked off with a double dose of portraits, a refreshing drink, and a perfect cocktail setup.  The day continued with a hearty breakfast on April 3rd, finishing off with a balcony scene featuring potted plants and a sunny outlook.
